shellCommands.command: cat package.json && ls -R app lib 2>/dev/null && cat app/page.tsx lib/api.ts 2>/dev/null; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

grep -rn "cacheComponents\|useCache" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "use cache" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "cacheComponents\|enabled" | head -5; grep -rn "To use \"use cache\"" node_modules/next/dist -r --include=*.js | head -3
sed -n 1625,1650p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts; grep -n "hours\|export declare function cacheLife" node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.d.ts | head

cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | grep -A3 paths; cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF'
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
}

export default nextConfig
EOF
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
